**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The document imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Northwind Analytics. I checked the planner's candidate sections (§ 30 General, § 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality) and ran targeted searches for the detection triggers ("solicit", "induce", "employ or engage", "hire", "recruit"). Nothing surfaced.

Instead, § 12.3 works in our favour: it expressly preserves our freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that we have made no no-hire commitment. That satisfies the rule's **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer), so there is no need to fall back to the mutual 12-month formulation.

One observation noted in the rationale but not flagged: § 12.4 restrains Vendor from developing or marketing a service competing with our proprietary analytics products. That is a restraint on the counterparty benefiting us, so it is not a deviation under this rule.
